items.exampleEn: There was no time to hesitate, so I jumped.
items.exampleZh: 沒時間猶豫了，所以我跳了下去。

items.exampleEn: The tired runner stumbled near the finish line.
items.exampleZh: 疲憊的跑者在終點線附近絆了一下。

items.exampleEn: The sad news united the whole team.
items.exampleZh: 這個悲傷的消息讓整個團隊團結起來。

items.exampleEn: Soap dissolves slowly in cold water.
items.exampleZh: 肥皂在冷水裡溶解得很慢。

items.exampleEn: When I was twelve, I had a crush on a singer.
items.exampleZh: 我十二歲時暗戀過一位歌手。

items.exampleEn: Children learn by interacting with others.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們透過與他人互動來學習。

items.exampleEn: The noise from the surrounding streets kept me awake.
items.exampleZh: 周圍街道的噪音讓我睡不著。

items.sentenceEn: Stir the tea until the sugar dissolves.

items.audioEn: My aunt is a lawyer who specializes in family problems.
items.audioZh: 我阿姨是一位專門處理家庭問題的律師。

items.sentenceEn: The two small towns united to form one city.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩個小鎮合併成一座城市。

items.sentenceEn: The village and the surrounding hills are covered in snow.
items.sentenceZh: 村莊和周圍的山丘都被雪覆蓋。

items.stemEn: Robots can now ____ with people and answer simple questions.
items.stemZh: 機器人現在能和人互動，回答簡單的問題。

items.stemEn: He ____ for a moment before he answered the hard question.
items.stemZh: 他回答那個難題前猶豫了一下。

items.passageEn: On my first day at a new school, I didn't know anyone. I hesitated at the door of my classroom. When I finally walked in, I stumbled over a bag and almost fell. Everyone laughed, and I felt embarrassed, but a girl named Ella helped me up. Later, I found out that she wants to specialize in science when she grows up, just like me. In science class, we watched salt dissolve in water. Ella and I interacted a lot during the class, and we became friends. My little sister thinks I have a crush on Ella, but she is just my best friend. Our class also united to plan a party, and we explored the surrounding area together.
items.passageZh: 轉學第一天，我誰也不認識。我在教室門口猶豫了一下。終於走進去時，我被一個書包絆了一下，差點跌倒。大家都笑了，我覺得好尷尬，但一個叫 Ella 的女生扶我起來。後來我發現，她長大後想專攻科學，就跟我一樣。自然課上，我們看著鹽在水裡溶解。課堂上 Ella 和我有很多互動，我們成了朋友。我妹妹以為我暗戀 Ella，但她只是我最好的朋友。我們班也團結起來籌備一場派對，還一起去探索了周圍一帶。

questions.questionZh: 作者走進教室時發生了什麼事？
options: 被書包絆了一下，差點跌倒
跟老師打招呼時叫錯了老師的名字

questions.questionZh: 為什麼作者和 Ella 成了朋友？
options: 因為自然課上兩人有很多互動
因為老師安排兩人坐一起
因為兩人的媽媽是朋友

items.promptZh: 如果需要幫忙，不要猶豫，打電話給我。
referenceEn: If you need help, don't hesitate to call me.
Don't hesitate to call me if you need help.
rubricZh: hesitate 表示「猶豫」，例如 don't hesitate to… 等說法
句型配合內容（例如 Don't hesitate to…，也可用 If you need help, … 等）

referenceEn: In this museum, visitors can interact with the displays.
This museum lets visitors interact with the things on show.
rubricZh: 用 interact with 表示「和…互動」
